command: make bench-all RUNTIMES="oxphp-classic oxphp-worker" MODE=ramp THREADS=32 CONNECTIONS=256 OUTPUT_ROOT=results/samdark_2026-10-02-rerun
notes: Full rerun after removing the outer try/finally around oxphp_worker().
Both modes and endpoints use the same 13-stage ramp, 32 load-generator threads, and 256 connections as the previous runs.
Other development containers were running on the host.
These results replace the earlier October 2 OxPHP measurements in the combined report; earlier raw results remain archived.

During worker DB overload, the application network namespace had 28,033 TCP sockets in TIME_WAIT and 2,211 ESTABLISHED; its ephemeral port range was 32768–60999. Fresh error samples and connection diagnostics are retained alongside this rerun.

system.filesystem: ext4 on LUKS-encrypted storage for the application and Docker data; Docker uses overlayfs

report_notes: OxPHP results are a full rerun after simplifying worker shutdown. Worker DB again began returning errors at the 30,000 RPS target. Logs show PostgreSQL connection failures (Address not available) and PostgreSQL rejecting connections with too many clients already. These failures are included in the results; the other three OxPHP runs completed without recorded errors.
